items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Harlan Leonard, yeah. Let me see, Jay McShann, Harlan Leonard, Teddy Wilson, Coleman Hawkins, and there was another band, I can't think who it was. So I got the gig up there.

ctx.x: In the meantime, the guys... The Golden Gate had just opened up, and they got five bands up there. You know, Coleman was up there, Teddy was up there with his band, Jay McShann had a band, let me see, who else was up there... Let me see, Jay McShann... Leonard...

Harlan Leonard, yeah. Let me see, Jay McShann, Harlan Leonard, Teddy Wilson, Coleman Hawkins, and there was another band, I can't think who it was. So I got the gig up there. I didn't want to go there now, remember, because I just felt like with all those bands, I figure there's gonna be some shit about the money. Heh-heh.
